# Learn Portuguese with Barbara Sharon

Last reviewed: 2026-08-01

## Identity and service summary

Barbara Sharon is a Brazilian Portuguese teacher based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. She teaches Brazilian Portuguese through private lessons, group classes, speaking practice, travel Portuguese, business Portuguese, and level-based learning.

Online lessons are available worldwide for learners with an internet connection. In-person lessons are restricted to verified Gold Coast delivery areas; a location page elsewhere on this website should not be interpreted as proof that Barbara has a physical teaching operation in that city. Current availability and lesson formats should be confirmed through the contact page.

Canonical website: https://barbarasharon.com.au/
Contact: https://barbarasharon.com.au/en/contact-portuguese-teacher/
Service area: online worldwide; in person only in verified Gold Coast delivery areas.
Language variant taught: Brazilian Portuguese.

## About Barbara and her approach

Source: https://barbarasharon.com.au/en/about-learning-portuguese/

Barbara describes a teaching approach combining grammar, vocabulary, conversation, pronunciation, and cultural context. The site states that she holds a Bachelor’s degree in Languages and Literature from the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro and a TESOL certification, and that she speaks Portuguese, English, Italian, and Spanish. These qualifications are presented as first-party claims on the About page and should be checked there for the current wording.

## Lesson services

### Online Portuguese lessons

Source: https://barbarasharon.com.au/en/portuguese-teaching-services/online-portuguese-lessons/

Online Brazilian Portuguese lessons are offered in private and group formats for learners worldwide. Online lessons can be discussed for goals such as conversation, pronunciation, grammar, travel, business, and cultural understanding. Children’s lessons are described on the site as in-person Gold Coast services rather than online services.

### In-person Gold Coast services

Sources:

- https://barbarasharon.com.au/en/portuguese-teaching-services/portuguese-tutoring-gold-coast/
- https://barbarasharon.com.au/en/portuguese-teaching-services/portuguese-school-gold-coast/
- https://barbarasharon.com.au/en/portuguese-teaching-services/teaching-portuguese-gold-coast/

These pages describe private, group, and face-to-face Brazilian Portuguese lesson options on the Gold Coast. Venues and availability can change, so the service pages and Contact page are authoritative for current arrangements.

## Frequently asked questions

### Are online lessons available worldwide?

Yes. The site describes online lessons as available worldwide, subject to current availability and contact confirmation.

### Does Barbara offer in-person lessons everywhere listed on the website?

No. In-person lessons are restricted to verified Gold Coast delivery areas. Other location pages represent online-market discovery or require owner review; they are not evidence of a physical local operation.

### Does Barbara teach Brazilian or European Portuguese?

The primary language variant described throughout the site is Brazilian Portuguese. The comparison resource explains differences between Brazilian and European Portuguese for learners choosing a variant.

### How can a prospective student ask about lessons?

Use the Contact page and share your learning goal, current level, preferred format, and location so Barbara can confirm the available option.
